status: corrected tenth proposal passes both native/full-schema replays and all nine applicable automatic checks; no hosted or application integration
implemented: An authenticated original uploader with unchanged review intent and current explicit edit access can request a durable review hold. The first reason/timestamp are retained. Repeating the same request returns the same receipt; foreign, registered, changed-reason and removed-access requests are denied.

Client Storage metadata INSERT requires the exact reserved actor/path and matching owner, in addition to existing permissive policies and current edit access. Anonymous database roles cannot use a forged subject or broad permissive grant to insert. Other buckets and trusted service maintenance retain existing policy behavior.

The insertion predicate holds the attempt FOR SHARE until the metadata transaction ends. Hold and registration lock the same attempt FOR UPDATE. No physical bytes, provider processing, reservation release, deletion or retry is performed.
Unknown preexisting review_required states cause installation to stop rather than inventing provenance. Direct ledger mutation and direct service/anonymous RPC execution remain unavailable.
